projection: d3-geo geoTransverseMercator on a sphere (R = 6371.0088 km), rotate([-lon0, -lat0]) so the origin and central meridian sit at the spherical centroid of Hamilton County (FIPS 18057); output km with x = east, y = north (d3's screen y negated). Transverse Mercator scale factor stays below 1.0001 inside the padded road box; the spherical model keeps distances within ~0.3% of the WGS84 ellipsoid.

sources: town coordinates: fixed WGS84 constants in scripts/build-geo.ts
meta.roadsNote: named routes only (I-, US-, SR-); clipped to bbox + 10 km; same-name segments chained; dual carriageways and concurrent stretches under a higher-class route drawn once; Douglas-Peucker 0.05 km
meta.i69Note: I-69 clipped to Hamilton County plus 15 km south, ordered south-west to north-east
